column1: # The test pairs Change Studio offers: before/after photos from PASLCD, the Pose-Agnostic
# Scene-Level Change Detection dataset (Galappaththige et al., CVPR 2025; MIT License),
# Each scene was photographed before and after objects were moved, added or taken away, along
# independent paths; every "after" photo has a hand-drawn change mask. A change pair is an
# after photo and the before photo taken from the nearest viewpoint (COLMAP poses in the
# dataset). A same pair is two before photos a few degrees apart: nothing changed, so any
# detection is a false alarm. Instance 1 has steady lighting, instance 2 changed lighting.
